dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Let me guess what you need most right now... A medicinal drink that can restore your full strength in one sip? Or maybe a cream that can instantly heal your wounds?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: How'd I do? All this and more available right here, right now. Buy in bulk for big discounts.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Don't let the price put you off. You're paying for all the hard work I and my private associates put in to bring these goods all the way from Sumeru.
